WildSpark 2.1.4 fixes module enable switches and WildAuctions window switching.

- Disabling WildAuctions now suppresses its automatic auction-house window, prevents the Open button from silently re-enabling it, and restores Blizzard's native auction-house UI.
- The WildAuctions Blizzard UI control now hides its window when switching to Blizzard's UI. Blizzard's auction-house window has a WildAuctions button to switch back.
- Disabling WildGroups closes its open window and hides its entry points.
- Includes the WildDrops initialization fix from 2.1.3.
